what.fr: Un ingénieur de Scion a répondu que, Claude étant de loin le plus gros utilisateur de Scion et nécessairement en ligne, le support hors ligne n'était pas important.
what.en: A Scion engineer replied that since Claude is by far the heaviest user of Scion and is necessarily online, offline support wasn't important.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say the speaker is a Scion engineer or that this was a reply, and it does not mention offline support; the URL alone does not establish these details.

what.fr: Google a affiné son modèle léger Gemma sur des conversations d'arnaques locales pour la détection d'arnaques.
what.en: Google's lightweight Gemma model was fine-tuned on local scam conversations for scam detection.

rejected.detail: The quote says Gemma was fine-tuned on local scam conversations but does not mention scam detection as the purpose, though this is only implied by the URL.

what.fr: Le pipeline comporte deux étapes : un classifieur léger filtre les messages entrants avec une consommation minimale, puis le Gemma affiné analyse un extrait plus large de la conversation pour confirme
what.en: The pipeline has two stages: a lightweight classifier screens inbound messages using minimal power, then the fine-tuned Gemma model analyzes a larger snapshot of the conversation to confirm a threat o

rejected.detail: The quote covers only stage 2; the lightweight classifier screening inbound messages with minimal power is not in the quote.

what.fr: Les arnaques représentent plus de la moitié des crimes signalés à Singapour et plus de 4 milliards de S$ de pertes depuis 2019.
what.en: Scams make up over half of Singapore's reported crimes and account for more than S$4 billion in losses since 2019.

rejected.detail: The quote has no explicit subject; the claim assumes it refers to scams, which is not established by the quote alone.

what.fr: Dans le test d'AWS (72 exécutions d'agent), l'agent a répondu correctement à 67 exécutions sur 72, dont les 18 sur 18 au niveau d'effort xhigh.
what.en: In AWS's test of 72 agent runs, the agent answered 67 of the 72 runs correctly, including all 18 at the xhigh effort level.

rejected.detail: The quote does not mention AWS's test or that the 72 runs were agent runs, beyond what the URL implies; it also frames xhigh without confirming the 72-run total as stated in the claim text.

what.fr: Grok 4.7 est accessible sur Bedrock via deux profils d'inférence inter-régions : us.xai.grok-4.7 (routage aux États-Unis) et global.xai.grok-4.7 (régions AWS commerciales).
what.en: Grok 4.7 is accessed on Bedrock through two cross-Region inference profiles: us.xai.grok-4.7 (routing within the US) and global.xai.grok-4.7 (commercial AWS Regions).

rejected.detail: The quote says two profiles are available but does not list their names or routing scopes.

what.fr: Les jetons de raisonnement comptent comme jetons de sortie et consomment max_completion_tokens avant le texte de réponse ; si la limite est atteinte pendant le raisonnement, la réponse n'a pas de text
what.en: Reasoning tokens count as output tokens and draw down max_completion_tokens before the answer text; if the limit is reached during reasoning, the response returns without answer text.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say that the response has no text if the limit is reached during reasoning.

what.fr: Le nombre moyen de jetons de sortie par exécution passe de 1 184 au niveau low à 9 147 au niveau xhigh, tandis que les appels d'outils restent à peu près constants (17,2 à 18,7).
what.en: Mean output tokens per run rose from 1,184 at low to 9,147 at xhigh, while tool calls stayed roughly flat (17.2 to 18.7).

rejected.detail: The quote covers only the flat tool calls; the output token means of 1,184 and 9,147 are not in the quote.

what.fr: Dans les conditions contrôlées de l'étude, Gated KalmaNet (GKA) est la meilleure couche à espace d'états, suivie de Gated DeltaNet (GDN) puis de Mamba-2.
what.en: Under the study's controlled conditions, Gated KalmaNet (GKA) performs best among the state space models, followed by Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and then Mamba-2.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say that GKA, GDN and Mamba-2 are state space models or that they are the best among them in a layer sense beyond ranking.

what.fr: Anthropic remplace Git par un nouveau système de contrôle de version
what.en: Anthropic replaces Git with a new source control system

rejected.detail: The headline claims Anthropic replaces Git with a new system, which the cited claims only imply through migration from Git, and the analysis about strain on tooling goes beyond the facts.

what.fr: Un modèle affiné avec GovTech Singapore fonctionne entièrement sur l'appareil
what.en: A model fine-tuned with GovTech Singapore runs entirely on-device

rejected.detail: The headline says a model fine-tuned with GovTech Singapore, but the cited claims do not establish the model purpose or that DeepMind fine-tuned it, and the cited facts cover only a subset; the privacy-design framing is acceptable but the title is not fully supported.
